div.class: card bg-light border-0 p-3 rounded-3 mt-3 shadow-sm
div.p: 1. In your Shopify Admin, navigate to: Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps.
2. Create an app and grant Admin API access scopes for Orders, Products, Inventory, Customers.
3. Install the app, copy the Admin API access token (starts with shpat_), and paste it into the field on the left.
4. Click Connect & Test in the header to activate your integration!
